items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA4MzAxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--468a4087b16789d8fa04e058bb93f8f219cb84e7/writing%20contest.%20(2).png) # Welcome to Dare to DR Rizal 2025! # Dare to DR Rizal 2025 is an official WCA competition featuring a wide variety of events, including **3x3, 5x5, 7x7, Pyraminx, Skewb, 4x4 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind**, and highlights **3x3 Fewest Moves** as the main event. This competition also **aims to encourage more cubers to explore and learn Domino Reduction (DR)**—the most advanced method currently used in Fewest Moves solving. * **3x3 Multi-Blind** is limited to **25 competitors,** and it's on a first-come and first-served basis. * **2-Person Mini Guilford** and **Master Magic** will also be held as unofficial events. For more information, please visit the [Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DaretoDRRizal2025#61609-must-read-unofficial-events) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1bebd0144612f93a0dcf3a3fe3a47b3623ad1272/image.png) El reto más mental del speedcubing regresa a Tijuana. FMC Tijuas III 2025 evoluciona con la llegada de Big Blind. Tres intentos, máxima concentración y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no importa la velocidad, sino la estrategia. ¿Te atreves a resolver sin ver? ¿Podrás encontrar la solución en menos movimientos? **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** The most mind-focused challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas III 2025 levels up with the introduction of Big Blind. Three attempts, full concentration, and now blindfolded solving. It’s not about speed — it’s about precision and planning. Can you solve without sight? Can you find the most efficient solution? **This competition does not include 3x3**

items.name: SacCubing XXI 2025
items.information: ### Registration is currently full and the waitlist is now closed. We will no longer be accepting anymore competitors onto the waitlist for this competition. #### Competitors from the waitlist will be accepted until Friday, September 19, 2025 at 5:00 PM, after which point all waitlisted competitors will not be able to compete. Competitors who do not make it off the waitlist will receive full refunds. Please click the [Waitlist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXXI2025#64129-waitlist) tab for more details. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzYyMDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b461cbfe0cad33e2120f14293fe68e84c3bb5009/sac_transparent%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) #### SacCubing returns with our 21st iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot! * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.
